summary: Standing guide (full text: executiveagent/docs/RELATIONSHIP_CULTIVATION_RETENTION.md). RETAIN, mapped to the executive schema: identity & role (executive.people: full_name, title, organization_id, email, linkedin_url); organization & fund (executive.organizations: org_type, website, location, focus, dated fund facts in notes); contact channels the contact gave professionally; how met / who introduced (people.notes + first executive.communications row); investment focus & thesis fit (organizations.focus + public.executive_opportunities with category, eligibility as they stated it, fit rationale marked as our assessment); typical check size/stage (opportunities.amount_estimate labelled typical; amount_verified only for a written amount for us; real amounts move to executive.funding_commitments and count as funding only when funds_cleared); personal-professional context, dated facts only (people.notes: stated interests, working preferences, best cadence, colleagues); EVERY interaction same-day (executive.communications: channel, direction, summary with commitments verbatim; meetings also in executive.appointments with outcome + follow_up_at); follow-up obligations as executive.tasks with due_at (feeds deadline monitoring), opportunity next_action kept mirrored; decisions in executive.decisions (supersede, never rewrite). STAGES: identified -> researched -> introduced(contacted) -> cultivating(engaged) -> engaged(meeting) -> diligence -> committed -> declined; a stage advances only on interaction evidence, committed requires something written, and funded only on cleared funds. BEFORE ANY FOLLOW-UP, re-read: the person row + notes, the last three communications (especially commitments), open tasks for the contact, the opportunity row, the organization focus, and related decisions. DO NOT RETAIN: sensitive personal data (health, family, politics, religion, private life); credentials or secrets of any kind; financial account details; private contact channels not given for the relationship; speculation recorded as fact (inferences are written as inferences, dated); third-party gossip unattributed; full private message bodies beyond the working summary. Hygiene: monthly review of cultivating/dormant contacts; corrections applied same-day; every fact lives in exactly the table the guide assigns, dated.
title: Relationship cultivation retention guide — what to retain for potential-investor relationships
